newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB spokesman says no rate change in pipeline.
newsitem.headline: SNB spokesman says no rate change in pipeline.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank has no plans in the pipeline to change interest rates, an SNB spokesman said.
"Is there something in the pipeline? No," spokesman Werner Abegg told Reuters when asked about a Swiss newspaper interview with SNB chairman Hans Meyer.

Abegg said Meyer, in the newspaper Neue Luzerner Zeitung, was simply repeating the central bank's stance that interest rates would rise at some point once there are clear signs of growth in the stagnant Swiss economy.

Meyer was quoted by the Lucerne newspaper as saying that low Swiss interest rates would have to be tightened once the economy takes off. "This point in time will certainly come," Meyer told the paper.
